To: [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh
We are focused with renewed focus and commitment not just as DRG but as an agency to mitigate negative implications
of technology on democracy and democratic participation around the world.
Through our advancing digital democracy initiative, we are focused to support open, secure, and inclusive digital
ecosystems that advance democracy, counter digital authoritarianism, promote digital literacy and provide equitable
access to underserved communities worldwide.
DRG is leading the way at USAID to address disinformation related challenges through programming, support our
missions, and implementing partners to reduce vulnerabilities and build resilience in society and information environment,
so that we mitigate the most damaging effects of disinformation, mis, and malinformation from countries like Russia, the
PRC, and internal domestic actors online and offline.
We are committed to doing so through effective partnerships with our interagency partners in Washington and around the
world, big tech, and emerging technologies, and local partners on the ground.
We brought on Vera to lead us on these efforts at agency, IA, etc (cut or keep, or whatever title you want to assign to me).
We know local voices, perspectives, and insights are critical to addressing tech in service for democracy. This is why I
hope you'll consider being our partners, co-conspirator in these efforts.
